entrance.title: Make an entrance
entrance.text: Roll a six to move a piece out of your yard. A six gives you another roll.

home.title: Make your way home
home.text: Move clockwise around the track, then up your colored lane. You need an exact roll to finish.

rivalry.title: A friendly little rivalry
rivalry.text: Land on an opponent to send their piece back. Star and entry squares are safe. Captures and finishes earn a bonus turn.

fair.title: Keep it fair
fair.text: Three consecutive sixes forfeit the third roll. Earlier moves remain. Two coins of the same color block an opponent from landing on that square.

finish.title: Bring everyone home
finish.text: The first player to finish all four pieces wins. Signed-in players earn coins and XP: online wins pay the most, and every online game scores tournament points.
